fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement_scope_raw is 'Business Administration', corresponding to AUC's Onsi Sawiris School of Business.

english_course_availability.notes: English-taught tracks and electives are widely offered across Global BBA and Master in Management exchange programs alongside French-taught offerings (https://em-lyon.com/en/exchange-students-master-management).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 CEFR level in English required for English-taught tracks (standard benchmarks: IELTS >= 6.0 / TOEFL iBT >= 80, or equivalent TOEIC/Cambridge/partner confirmation). RHET 1020 waiver not stated.

host_language_requirement.value: French not required for English-taught exchange tracks; B2 French recommended if selecting French-taught courses.

fall_term_dates.value: Early September to late December (exact semester dates vary by GBBA vs MiM)

spring_term_dates.value: Early January/February to late April/May (exact semester dates vary by GBBA vs MiM)

tuition_model.notes: Incoming academic exchange students under partner agreements pay tuition at their home institution and have emlyon tuition fees waived.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2025-2026 MiM exchange fact sheet estimates overall cost of living at EUR 1,000/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate: 1,000 EUR/month * 5 months = 5,000 EUR * 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5,526.00 USD (ECB 2026-11-13 rate, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Bilateral exchange students are EXEMPT from the French CVEC student life fee (obtain free exemption certificate at cvec.etudiant.gouv.fr per Campus France/etudiant.gouv.fr). Registration for French Sécurité Sociale (etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr) is mandatory for stays >3 months, plus third-party civil liability insurance (~EUR 10).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: CVEC exemption rules verified via official French student portal (etudiant.gouv.fr / campusfrance.org); ameli portal via https://etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr/#/.

housing_availability.notes: No on-campus dormitories; emlyon assists incoming students via its dedicated Studapart platform, private student residences (e.g., Nomad Campus), and homestay/intergenerational partners.

housing_notes.value: Off-campus/private residences supported via emlyon's Studapart portal and partner residence networks in Lyon.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students staying >90 days must obtain a French VLS-TS long-stay student visa via Etudes en France (pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance) / France-Visas before departure. Effective August 1, 2026, Décret n° 2026-526 increased minimum student financial proof from EUR 615/mo to EUR 877.50/month (EUR 10,530/year; 47% of gross SMIC).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Visa portals also listed at https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/visa-wizard and https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS system. Global BBA exchange: 25–35 ECTS per semester (Year 3/4 courses). Master in Management (MiM): 2 to 6 graduate elective courses per semester (standard 5 ECTS / 24 contact hours each, ~27.5–30 ECTS full load).

course_restrictions_note.value: Undergraduate exchange students select from Global BBA Year 3 or Year 4 courses; graduate exchange students select from MiM electives (2–6 courses).

campus_type.notes: Urban Lyon Gerland campus located at 144 avenue Jean Jaurès, 69007 Lyon.

international_support_services.value: Incoming Students desk, Studapart housing portal, First Steps in France visa/Sécurité Sociale onboarding support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester: partner nomination May 1, student application May 15. Spring Semester: partner nomination October 1, student application October 10.
